candidates.title: Anthropic Warns Small AI Models Could Soon Form Self-Propagating IoT Botnets
candidates.summary: Small artificial intelligence (AI) models may be months away from developing capabilities to self-replicate on IoT devices like smart ovens and off-brand Android TV boxes, according to a warning from Anthropic.
